name: Nifty 50 Total Returns Index (TRI)
description: Historical benchmark index capturing dividend reinvestments and broad Indian large-cap equity market performance.
intendedUse: Historical benchmark simulation and long-term equity risk/return education.
refreshFrequency: Daily (trading days only); re-run `npm run import:nifty` to extend coverage.
fields: tri (Total Returns Index level, 2 decimals, positive float)
ntr (Net Total Return index level, present when published)
accessNotes: Public free access. Max 365 days per query (pipeline auto-splits into yearly chunks with 250 ms pauses). Manual fallback: CSV export from the historical-data portal saved to data/raw/nifty_tri_manual.csv, then `node scripts/importNifty.js --local`. NSE Indices data-usage terms and intellectual-property rights apply; used here for non-commercial educational display.
licenseOrConstraints: NSE Indices data-usage terms and intellectual-property rights apply; used for non-commercial educational display.

name: AMFI Mutual Fund NAV & Scheme Master
provider: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
description: Historical Net Asset Value (NAV) data across Indian mutual fund schemes and open-ended index funds.
intendedUse: Educational fund categorization, SIP compounding demonstration, and category average comparisons.
refreshFrequency: Daily (NAV snapshot after ~10 PM IST via NAVAll.txt master); historical series re-run `npm run import:amfi`.
coveragePeriod: 120716 UTI Nifty 50 Index Fund - Growth Option- Direct: 2024-01-01 to 2026-10-23 (694 observations); 119063 HDFC Nifty 50 Index Fund - Direct Plan - Growth Option: 2024-01-01 to 2026-10-23 (694 observations)
accessNotes: Public free access. Historical endpoint enforces ~90-day (one quarter) windows; responses >120 days redirect to the HTML homepage. NAVAll.txt is a daily SNAPSHOT (one row per scheme), not a time series. Subject to AMFI fair usage policy for non-commercial educational purposes.

name: SEBI Riskometer / Product Labelling
provider: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
description: The six-level Riskometer (Low to Very High) that AMCs must display for every MF scheme and benchmark, per SEBI product-labelling guidelines (Risk-o-meter evaluated monthly and disclosed with portfolio disclosures on AMC and AMFI websites).
intendedUse: Grounding scheme-risk explanations in the official SEBI six-level scale and colour scheme when presenting fund risk in the Learn/Invest flows.
updateFrequency: Circular-driven; monthly Riskometer evaluation by AMCs
refreshFrequency: Re-check when SEBI revises product-labelling circulars.
fields: riskLevels: Low / Low to Moderate / Moderate / Moderately High / High / Very High
officialColourScheme: Irish Green, Chartreuse, Neon Yellow, Caramel, Dark Orange, Red
accessNotes: Official public regulatory material, free to access. Cite the circular number when surfacing Riskometer explanations (see relatedUrls).

relatedUrls.colourSchemeCircular: SEBI circular Nov-2024 (disclosure of expenses, half yearly returns, yield and risk-o-meter)
relatedUrls.masterCircularClause: Clause 17.4 of the Master Circular for Mutual Funds

note: Riskometer data files live on individual AMC websites; no single official bulk download exists, so WealthGenie links out instead of scraping.
licenseOrConstraints: Official public regulatory material (SEBI circulars); six-level Riskometer disclosed to investors free of charge; cite the circular when reproduced.

name: AMC Monthly Factsheets & Scheme Documents
provider: Individual Asset Management Companies (via AMFI index)
description: Official monthly scheme factsheets (portfolio holdings, risk ratios, performance, TER), SIDs/KIMs, and annual reports published by each AMC and indexed by AMFI.
intendedUse: Scheme-level attributes (fund manager, risk ratios, expense ratio, benchmark) for educational fund profiles — linked, never bulk-scraped.
accessNotes: Public documents issued by the AMCs for investor information. No bulk scraping: download specific PDFs manually for the schemes actively used. Documents are the copyright of the respective AMCs — used for educational display with attribution.
otherMajorAmcUrlsNote: Most other leading AMCs publish at <amc-website>/downloads/factsheet style pages; always start from AMFI's official factsheet index above rather than third-party mirrors.
licenseOrConstraints: Documents are the copyright of the respective AMCs; public investor disclosures used for educational display with attribution. No bulk scraping.

name: RBI Banking & Deposit Statistics
description: Official deposit trends and structure data: annual/quarterly BSR-2 'Deposits with Scheduled Commercial Banks' (type, ownership, maturity, size, interest-rate ranges), fortnightly aggregate deposits (Form-A), and monthly Composition/Ownership Pattern of Deposits.
intendedUse: Passive-investing / FD-vs-equity educational comparisons grounded in official RBI statistics.
updateFrequency: BSR-2 quarterly (excluding RRBs) + annual; aggregate deposits fortnightly; composition of deposits monthly.
refreshFrequency: Quarterly is sufficient for educational use.
coveragePeriod: Latest completed reporting period (annual reference date end-March; quarterly reference dates end of each quarter).
accessNotes: Free public releases on the Database on Indian Economy (DBIE) portal: data.rbi.org.in > Publications. Open data for research/educational use with attribution to RBI. No restricted scraping needed; downloadable Excel/CSV publications are available. Example release: 'Annual Basic Statistical Return (BSR)-2 on Deposits with Scheduled Commercial Banks – March 2026' (announced 29 May 2026).
manualCollectionSteps: 2. Choose the latest BSR-2 'Deposits with Scheduled Commercial Banks' (quarterly or annual).
3. Download the relevant Excel/CSV tables and copy into data/raw/rbi/ with the original file name.
4. Run the data-quality gate: node scripts/validateDataQuality.js.
licenseOrConstraints: RBI statistical releases — open data for research/educational use with attribution to the Reserve Bank of India.

name: FD Interest Rates (Bank Official Pages)
provider: Individual scheduled commercial banks (SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, et al.)
description: Current retail fixed-deposit interest rates and maturity schemas published on each bank's own website; RBI also publishes a monthly aggregated 'Lending and Deposit Rates of Scheduled Commercial Banks' data release.
intendedUse: Illustrative FD comparisons. Rates must always be read from a bank's official page at display time or stored with an explicit retrieval date — never invented or extrapolated.
status: Documented for manual collection (not connected; no rates stored yet)
updateFrequency: Banks reprice irregularly; RBI aggregated release monthly.
refreshFrequency: Manual check whenever FD comparisons are shown; display with the access date.
coveragePeriod: Current rates only (no historical) — point-in-time official pages.
accessNotes: Bank rate pages are freely viewable. No scraping of restricted/paged data; copy only the slab table that a member of the public can view openly, always with the date of access. Prefer RBI's aggregated series for thematic use.
caution: Bank rate-page URLs occasionally move. If a link 404s, go to the bank homepage > Interest Rates. If no official rate is verified, show the honest unconnected state instead of an approximate rate.
licenseOrConstraints: Bank-published rate information is public; copy only openly displayed slab tables with access date. RBI aggregated series is open data with attribution.

updateFrequency: Quarterly monetary policy and consumer advisories
fields: Consumer advisories, UPI safety guidance, DICGC insurance limits.
accessNotes: Official public awareness publications, free to access with attribution.
